subject: Old Friend
body:
Hi! It's me, your old friend Dr. Trayaurus. Grim says hello.

I've been writing down everything strange I find, and it's all in your Archive now. Floppy disks hold even more.

My lab is in Elythia. Right-click a Brown Ant and it'll transport you there. They nest in forests, taigas and plains.

Your old friend,
Dr. T
